test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"crossed."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Crossed"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It indicates that someone or something has gone from one side to the other, often by passing over a boundary or obstacle. (एक पार्श्‍व या पक्ष से दूसरे पार्श्‍व या पक्ष में जाना; पार करना) • The past tense of** "cross" is "crossed."** • **Example**: *The river was too deep to wade through, so we **crossed**__ it by using the bridge.* • The correct answer is option 1. • **Correct passage**: As I __**crossed**__ the stream and began climbing the hill, the grunting and chattering increased,......... [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "entered," **suggests going into something or somewhere. ((किसी स्‍थान में) प्रवेश करना, प्रवेश पाना) • **Option 3, "drowned,"** indicates that someone or something has died by being submerged in water. (डूबकर मरना; डुबोकर मारना) • **Option 4, "passed,"** means to move past or to the other side of somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से आगे या उसके दूसरी तरफ़ निकल जाना) 43:Tcb6, The correct answer is **"poised."**
